title: orchis × jenensis
intro: Orchis × jenensis, commonly known as the Jenensis orchid, is a hybrid orchid species resulting from the cross between Orchis italica and Orchis mascula. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Orchis × jenensis are thought to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit cardio-protective effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
